newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish retail sales up 2.16 pct yr/yr in July.
newsitem.headline: Spanish retail sales up 2.16 pct yr/yr in July.

text.p: Spanish overall retail sales data for July, according to the National Statistics Institute INE.
General index 111.45 up 8.49 pct up 2.16 pct

NOTE: Due to technical problems with the retail sales survey, INE had stopped releasing overall sales data in March. Sales figures given up to last month were solely for non-specialist hypermarkets, INE said.
The data given above correspond to overall retail sales, which have been re-calculated from the start of the year.
According to this freshly calculated data, overall retail sales fell 0.54 percent year-on-year in June while in May they rose 0.48 percent from the year-earlier month.
